label: Recipes as skills with manifests
subgoals: Write a manifest with target, objective, tunables and known limits
Match the design's target and failing metric against the manifests
Pick the recipe without reading engine source

label: Running and comparing candidates
subgoals: Gate every candidate on equivalence and timing before comparing area
Filter with fast estimates and decide with the reference timer
Stop on an iteration budget or a minimum improvement

label: Learning which recipe to pick
subgoals: Record design features, recipe, parameters and QoR for every run
Update manifests with the conditions under which a recipe wins
Ground rewards in reference-engine QoR rather than proxies
